description: This file defines the ReadingGoalService class, which manages CRUD operations for ReadingGoal entities, including finding by ID, listing all, saving, deleting, and counting goals. It enforces that only one reading goal exists at a time by deleting all previous goals before saving a new one.

classes.name: ReadingGoalService
classes.description: Service layer managing ReadingGoal entities, providing methods to find, save, delete, and count goals, while ensuring only one goal exists at a time.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a reading goal by its unique identifier.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a new reading goal after deleting previous ones to ensure only one goal exists.

methods.name: overwritePreviouslySetGoal
methods.description: Deletes all existing goals and saves the provided goal, maintaining a single active goal.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all reading goals from the repository.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of reading goals.
